evidence.quote: I support tightening policy by another 50 basis points for several meetings.
If the data suggest that inflation is stubbornly high, I am prepared to do more.
I said in December that inflation was alarmingly high, and it has remained so.
the U.S. economy continues to power along at a healthy pace.
This pace will reduce the Fed's securities holdings by about $1 trillion over the next year
I am left optimistic that the strong labor market can handle higher rates without a significant increase in unemployment.
